notes: «أخاه مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ» : «أخاه» plus a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7); the Imam asked is the last link (imam_in_text)
the blessing «عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is left out
«أخاه مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ» : «أخاه» plus a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7); the Imam asked is the last link (imam_in_text)
the blessing «عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is left out
«سأل علي بن جعفر أخاه موسى بن جعفر» makes the asker the first link and the Imam the last; «أخاه» is absorbed into the name (rule 7).
The Kafi correspondence gives another chain for the same saying; the text's own chain is read, not merged with it.
